title: Monotone Inclusion Approach to Weakly Monotone Discrete-Time Finite-Horizon Mean-Field Games
summary: We revisit the problem of computing mean-field equilibria (MFEs) in discrete-time, monotone, finite-horizon mean-field games (MFGs). We show that, when the transition kernel is independent of the state-measure term and the reward function satisfies the usual weak monotonicity condition and is Lipschitz continuous, anchored proximal gradient descent methods can be used to compute a monotone MFE. We also establish last-iterate convergence results for these methods. Our approach relies on formulating the computation problem as an optimization problem over the space of occupation measures.
